title: Castles and History Days Out for Kids and Teens
description: Castle and history days out for families: Warwick, Edinburgh, Dover and Caernarfon castles, the Tower of London, Stonehenge and fairy-tale Neuschwanstein.
intro: Knights, towers, dungeons and secret tunnels. Castles bring history to life, and many host jousts, sword shows and family trails.

image.alt: A stone castle under white clouds

blocks.title: Scout’s castle verdict
blocks.text: Check the events calendar. A joust or have-a-go archery turns a castle visit into a brilliant day. Memberships can make history days much cheaper.

sections.html: Memberships pay off fast if you love history: see National Trust vs English Heritage. Many sites let under-5s in free, and Heritage Open Days open historic places for free each September. Read Scout’s castles for kids.

faqs.q: What is the best castle to visit with kids in the UK?
faqs.a: Favourites include Warwick Castle, Edinburgh Castle, Dover Castle with its wartime tunnels, Caernarfon Castle and the Tower of London.

cardText: Warwick, Edinburgh, Dover, the Tower of London and more.
